title: Multiple appliances.
officialText:
Where two or more appliances are connected to a common vent or chimney, each vent
connector shall be sized in accordance with Section 504 or other approved engineering methods.
As an alternative method applicable only when all of the appliances are draft hood equipped, each vent connector shall have
an effective area not less than the area of the draft hood outlet of the appliance to which it is connected.
